description: Implementation of MerchantConfigurationService, managing merchant configurations including retrieval, update, deletion, and JSON serialization/deserialization within a Spring service context.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation handling merchant configuration operations such as CRUD and serialization/deserialization within a Spring framework context.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a merchant configuration based on a key and store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all configurations associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists configurations filtered by type for a specific store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a merchant configuration entity.

methods.description: Deletes a merchant configuration if it exists.
